data.exact_reserve_text: The 2012 Year of Account benefited from a benign loss year, with Superstorm Sandy being the most significant large loss, but was impacted by deterioration on the back years of account of GBP 0.3m. This comprises of an GBP 8.0m profit on the 2012 Year of Account partly offset by a deterioration of GBP 0.3m on the closed 2011 and prior Years of Account.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a small prior year strengthening of GBP 0.3 million in 2014, attributed to adverse claims development on the closed 2011 and prior years of account. This deterioration partly offset the profit generated by the 2012 year of account. The 2013 year of account, which is still developing, was impacted by several events including Hurricanes Manuel and Ingrid, Central European flooding, the Julius Klein Diamond heist, a diamond theft, and a cash in transit loss, as well as lower than forecast reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration on the back years of account of GBP 0.3m
impacted by deterioration on the back years of account of GBP 0.3m
The 2013 year of account has been impacted by Hurricanes Manuel and Ingrid, Central European flooding and the Julius Klein Diamond heist.
The class also suffered two notable large loss events; a diamond theft and a cash in transit loss, which has affected the account's performance relative to plan.

However, the attritional nature of the losses meant that these fell below the retention of the main property excess of loss programme in force during 2013, resulting in lower than forecast reinsurance recoveries.
